response.why: Their Preacher of the Schism (2/4 deathtouch) trades with Sheoldred if I attack and they block - deathtouch makes even a small hit lethal, so I'd lose my legendary bomb for their 3-drop. Sheoldred generates value every turn just by sitting there (2 life swing per draw), so I hold it back and develop with my own Preacher instead.
response.plan: Keep Sheoldred home as an engine/deathtouch blocker against ground creatures. Hold Enduring Curiosity (flash) for a reactive cast once I have 4+ spare mana - either as a surprise blocker or on their end step. Reassess attacking once I have enough board presence that trading Sheoldred isn't a net loss, or once their Preacher is gone.

response.why: At 1 life with no creatures, I need to see what I draw before committing to any play. Playing the land is free value; everything else depends on the draw - will ask if something castable shows up.
response.plan: At 1 life, completely exposed - need my draw to be a creature (blocker), removal, or a counterspell (We Say Thee Nay) to survive their next attack. Holding all remaining mana open in case I draw an instant-speed answer rather than committing to a sorcery-speed play.
